payload.claim: The acceptance criteria require that when a criterion has both an undriven `covers` member and an unguarded negative claim, the member's line must appear before the negation line. No test ever builds that case: in test_coverage_problems_names_each_declared_member_no_driver_reaches the claims are deliberately negation-free, and in test_coverage_problems_names_each_negative_claim_that_declares_no_positive_case the one criterion with `covers` (criterion 21) also declares `positive_case`, which suppresses the negation line entirely, so only the member line is ever produced from that criterion. Swapping the negation check to run before the covers loop (so the negation line would be emitted first whenever both apply) leaves every current test green, because none of them exercises a criterion where both outputs are produced together.
